key_findings: Chronic morphine retracts dorsal striatal MSN dendrites and reduces spines; D4R agonist PD168,077 restores spine density and reduces excitability
PD168,077 counteracts morphine-induced MOR upregulation in striatonigral inputs and GIRK1/2 downregulation in nigral dopamine cells
